VisualCardPool.maps_to: no counterpart; the sim has no card-pool artwork concept
VisualCardPool.rationale: `public override CardPoolModel VisualCardPool => ModelDb.CardPool<SilentCardPool>()` (Caltrops.cs:17) selects the ART/frame the card is drawn with. It is NOT `Pool`, which is what governs pool membership and generation, so it has no gameplay consequence. Presentation, and the sim has no field for it.

ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Power, CardRarity.Event, TargetType.Self)` (Caltrops.cs:21-24) == cost 1 / POWER / EVENT / SELF. No keywords.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new PowerVar<ThornsPower>(3m)` (Caltrops.cs:19) == `_power_amount = 3`. `_power_amount` is in `Card._MAGIC_ATTRS` (cards/base.py:185-189), so `magic_number` reports 3 and the observation encoder sees the right printed number -- contrast the inlined-var cards.

OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<ThornsPower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, DynamicVars["ThornsPower"].BaseValue, Owner.Creature, this)` (Caltrops.cs:29) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, ThornsPower, self._power_amount, applier=ctx.player)`. Presentation, folded in: TriggerAnim (28) and the Thorns hover tip (15).
